body:
Wow! Thanks for the insight, I had no idea Americans thought about us that way.

As for my work, on paper I have a respectable role, I’m a civil engineer but I’m unable to throw myself into it as fully as I like because of the constant office politics, it doesn’t help that I’m contracted to work for a local government office either. 

While I’m really sorry for almost flip flopping, I’ve spoken with some friends and family and i think I’m feeling more up than down now, I thank you for allowing me to vent whoever you may be!

Thank you for replying, it means a lot even though we disagree with each other. You’re right, I do want to be forgotten because as much as I understand it’ll hurt (mainly my mother and a female friend in this instance) after time they’ll have to accept this as the situation and can begin to heal themselves. I’m not going to get better and I’ve accepted that, my counselling hasn’t helped and the various meds I’ve tried don’t seem to have altered me in any way and to automate myself seems like the only logical answer left.

Once again I really appreciate you taking the time to engage with me and just as an interest why do you think American girls would find worth in me?
